dataEffects: Each unanswered charge holds a worker slot until the payment timeout.
Affected orders retry; once the charge budget is spent, they reconcile, and with no recorded charge they are voided and fail, releasing their stock.
Orders whose retried charge is answered are paid normally.
description: The payment provider stops answering a share of charge requests, so the worker times out, retries with backoff, and finally reconciles the affected orders.
expectedRemediation: Confirm charge calls succeed and payment latency returns to normal.

primarySymptom.description: Charge calls to the payment provider fail with an unknown outcome.

rootCause.summary: The payment provider leaves a share of charge requests unanswered until the client times out.
